author: tnappliancerepair-hub
description: Book appliance repair for your human: a real in-home repair job in Middle Tennessee and southeast Louisiana (we text or call within minutes to set the day), plus an honest technician diagnosis and a service-area check. Free remote MCP server from TN Appliance Exchange.
name: TN Appliance Exchange — appliance repair

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.title: About TN Appliance Exchange
tools.description: Who TN Appliance Exchange is, where they serve, services, how booking works (by day, not time), and their honesty and safety policies.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.title: Check service area
tools.description: Check whether a US zip code gets in-home appliance repair (Tennessee and Louisiana, except a few ZIPs we don't go to: Auburntown 37016, Castalian Springs 37031, Christiana 37037, Eagleville 37060, Shelbyville 37160). Anywhere else, returns the nationwide $50 video diagnostic option.

tools.name: diagnose_appliance_problem
tools.title: Diagnose an appliance problem
tools.description: Honest troubleshooting from working appliance technicians, grounded in real completed repairs. Give the appliance and symptom (plus brand, model and any error code if known). Returns likely causes, what is safe to check, and safety warnings. Never returns part numbers.

appliance.description: e.g. washer, dryer, refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, range, microwave

symptom.description: What is happening, in the person's words

model.description: Model number from the sticker, if known

error_code.description: Code on the display, if any

tools.name: get_social_content
tools.title: Get approved social media content
tools.description: Approved material for Facebook / Instagram / Google posts about TN Appliance Exchange: ready-to-post press release blurbs with links, real 5-star Google reviews (first name + last initial), hashtags, profile links, and the brand rules every post must follow (no part numbers, no customer info, no appointment times, no "best" claims). Optional topic filter, e.g. "dryer vent", "refrigerator", "Louisiana".

tools.name: book_repair
tools.title: Book an in-home appliance repair
tools.description: Book an in-home repair in Tennessee or Louisiana. Only call after the person has agreed to book and to be texted. Creates the job and TN Appliance Exchange texts them within minutes to pick the day. Never promise an appointment time.

phone.description: Mobile number that can receive texts

availability.description: Days that generally work, if they said

customer_confirmed.description: true only if the person explicitly agreed to book

sms_consent.description: true only if the person agreed to be texted about the repair
